chapter: Later views and life in Dallas
title: Never meeting King Oliver; Duke Huddleson
summary: Smith knew King Oliver only from records and says tenorist Duke Huddleson is a friend who recorded.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Did you ever hear King Oliver play?
No, I never did hear him. Only on records.
Well, he was going around in 1933-34.

Yeah. We missed him all the time. Like (?) and (?). We missed them all the time. They stayed back down in this part of the country, and went back out through the Mississippi and all down through there...
They used to work in Mississippi?
Are any of those guys still alive?
Yeah. One of them is a friend of mine who lives right here, and plays a whole lot of tenor, named Duke Huddleson.
